export_equivalence_result.prior_label: BYTE_IDENTICAL — every state_dict parameter torch.equal() to the source P2 checkpoint
export_equivalence_result.reason: Byte-identical parameter tensors were proven (test_export_matches_source_checkpoint_bytewise). That is only PARAMETER equality. It does NOT prove that a full forward pass through the exported model produces byte-identical LOGITS to a full forward pass through the source checkpoint. R2 will add the actual forward-logit comparison.

authentic_inference_path_proof.prior_label: Every generated token executes through aeon.hybrid.HybridModel via aeon.desktop.runtime.AeonDesktopRuntime
authentic_inference_path_proof.reason: test_runtime_generates_bounded_tokens_end_to_end verifies live 8-token generation through the authoritative model on Linux/CPU. This is real dynamic evidence for the linux path. It does NOT prove Windows behavior.

session_isolation_result.prior_label: PASS — two sessions maintain separate token_history; reset A leaves B unchanged
session_isolation_result.reason: test_runtime_session_isolation_two_sessions_have_separate_histories runs an actual pair of concurrent sessions with real generation and verifies histories diverge and reset propagates only to the target session. Dynamic evidence.

stop_result.prior_label: PASS — cancellation between token steps, runtime returns to READY, committed text preserved, no runtime kill
stop_result.reason: test_cancellation_mid_generation_returns_to_ready_and_preserves_committed spawns a real generation, cancels mid-flight after at least one token, verifies READY-state return, verifies the cancelled-event payload includes generated_tokens>=0 with committed text. Dynamic evidence.

recovery_result.prior_label: PASS — after a failed load, a fresh runtime instance loads the real bundle successfully
recovery_result.reason: test_recovery_after_failed_load_can_restart proves recovery from a MANIFEST-MISSING failure. It does NOT prove recovery from an in-flight runtime process crash — because the in-process design has no separate runtime process to crash. Recovery from crash-during-load, crash-during-generation, and orphan-process reaping are NOT proven.

shutdown_result.prior_label: PASS — shutdown during generation completes without hanging, timeout-bounded
shutdown_result.reason: test_shutdown_during_generation_completes_without_hanging asserts state == STOPPED after shutdown was called mid-generation. Dynamic evidence for the in-process design.

network_denial_result.prior_label: PASS — static AST scan of aeon.desktop.* finds zero forbidden network tokens; release_manifest.network_policy=offline_only
network_denial_result.reason: The prior test is a STATIC source-code scan. It never ran the desktop runtime with outbound networking blocked at the OS level or the socket level. That is the specific gap §8 requires closing.
network_denial_result.gap: no dynamic offline test with socket-level monkey-patch or intercepted egress

soak_result.prior_label: 25 sequential generation requests — every trial completed; peak RSS bounded
soak_result.reason: test_soak_25_sequential_generations_no_memory_growth_or_orphans really runs 25 requests and RSS-bounds at <3000MB. That is real dynamic soak evidence at the 25-request scale. It is NOT the §9 one-hour soak — soak duration was ~2 minutes, not 3600 seconds; time-alternating idle/generation/cancel/reset was not measured.
soak_result.gap: no ≥3600-second continuous soak; no interval sampling of memory/thread/handle trend

one_hour_soak.reason: no 3600-second continuous soak has been executed at d91a836

runtime_restart_cycles.reason: one-cycle recovery is proven for the failed-load case. Ten application-restart cycles are NOT run.

process_orphan_detection.reason: AeonDesktopRuntime is currently in-process. No supervised child process exists to be orphaned. §6 requires that the production design either be a supervised subprocess OR carry executable evidence that in-process is safe. Neither has been proven at d91a836; will be reconciled in R3.

frozen_runtime_execution.reason: packaging/windows/Aeon.spec was extended with aeon.desktop.* hidden imports and release-assets/ bundling. NO frozen build has actually been produced or executed at d91a836.

installer_build.reason: no installer artifact has been produced at d91a836

architecture_transformer_execution.reason: test_desktop_runtime_asserts_K16_and_ACIS_OFF verifies HybridModel.K==16 and Recursion parameters are fp32 after load. It does NOT verify per-token that the Transformer stream contributed non-zero output during generation. R2 will add a per-generation architectural trace.

architecture_substrate_execution.reason: same as Transformer — presence is asserted but per-generation execution trace is not captured

architecture_shared_broadcast_cardinalit.reason: the HybridModel source is unchanged and inherits the ACIS-8 invariant test that proves one broadcast per K-boundary. Under desktop generation, a per-generation trace has not been recorded. R2 will add it.

ladder_verdict_at_d91a836.reason: 'FUNCTIONAL_UNPACKAGED_DESKTOP' implied more evidence than existed. Nothing at d91a836 proves the desktop runs UNPACKAGED (as an installable-but-not-installed app on a fresh machine) — every test uses the source repo layout. FUNCTIONAL_LOCAL_BUILD is the honest floor: real dynamic tests pass on the developer's machine against the source-tree release bundle.
